title: On Turn-Level Best-of-N Sampling for Scaling LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work, we evaluate a simple inference-time scaling approach based on \textit{turn-level best-of-N sampling} (\method) for large language model (LLM) agents on complex, long-horizon tasks. We instantiate this using a \textit{generator-selector} framework with two LLMs; at each turn, a \emph{generator} model generates $N$ candidate actions and a \emph{selector} model selects one of them, which is then executed in the environment. This paper is closely related to the work of \cite{zainullina2025guided} who used critic models for guided search at inference time. Different from their work, we evaluate if off-the-shelf, open-weight LLMs can be effective at comparing different candidate actions directly. Experiments on long-horizon terminal tasks show that \method can lead to significant performance improvements, both in terms of accuracy (5--10\%) and consistency across repeated attempts. translated_title: 关于面向LLM智能体扩展的轮次级Best-of-N采样方法研究
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们评估了一种基于轮次级Best-of-N采样（\method）的简单推理时扩展方法，用于大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂、长时程任务上的表现。我们通过一个包含两个LLM的“生成器-选择器”框架来实现该方法：在每一轮中，生成器模型生成N个候选动作，选择器模型从中选择一个，随后该动作在环境中执行。本文与zainullina等人（2025）的工作密切相关，后者在推理时使用评论模型进行引导搜索。与他们的工作不同，我们评估了现成的开源权重LLM是否能够有效地直接比较不同的候选动作。在长时程终端任务上的实验表明，\method可以带来显著的性能提升，包括准确率（5-10%）和多次尝试之间的一致性。对智能体轨迹的分析揭示了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种轮次级Best-of-N采样的推理时扩展方法，通过生成器-选择器双模型框架在每轮生成并筛选候选动作，显著提升了LLM智能体在长时程任务上的准确率与稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a turn-level best-of-N sampling inference-time scaling method with a generator-selector two-model framework that generates and selects candidate actions each turn, significantly improving LLM agents' accuracy (5-10%) and consistency on long-horizon tasks.
